title: Classic layered Rachel
caption: A fictional South Asian woman in her 30s wearing a shoulder-length Rachel interpretation with pronounced rounded face framing, crown volume and outward-turning lower layers.
patternDescription: Presented with a Type 1B-like blow-dried finish: mostly straight through the strand with enough body to hold the rounded layer pattern; the image does not establish the model’s natural hair subtype.
lengthDescription: Medium length, with the longest sections brushing the shoulders and progressively shorter layers framing the cheeks, jaw and upper neck.
